body:
Found that while reviewing https://github.com/scikit-learn/scikit-learn/pull/32761.

_weighted_percentile ignores NaNs by setting their weight to zero on a sorted copy of the weights. In the average=True case, the original sample_weight is used so the weight of a nan is not zero.

Since the sorted nans are always last, only percentile_rank=100 would generate a nan in the output. Hence the extended parametrization of the existing test (it fails on main). 

I don't think it needs a changelog entry because this combination can't be reached from the public API today.
title: MNT Fix _weighted_percentile with nans and average=True
